discover.title: Discover
discover.damaged: The file of followed sources could not be read. You can set it aside (a copy is kept next to it) and start again with no sources.
discover.needsLibrary: Open a library to discover related work.

readnext.intro: Works cited by several documents of your library that you do not have yet. Computed on this computer from the stored citations: nothing goes online and no AI is used.
readnext.empty: Nothing to recommend with these settings.
readnext.few_one: Only {{count}} document has stored citations so far, so there is little to compare.
readnext.few_other: Only {{count}} documents have stored citations so far, so there is little to compare.
readnext.fewHint: Select documents in the library and use “Refresh citations” to fetch more; lowering the minimum also helps.
readnext.none: No document has stored citations yet. Select documents in the library and use “Refresh citations” first.
readnext.why: Why: cited by {{count}} of your documents

watch.intro: Works found by the sources you follow. Nothing is checked in the background: use “Check now” when you want to look.
watch.empty: Nothing new. Add sources in the Sources tab, then check.
watch.noSources: You follow no sources yet. Add one in the Sources tab.

published.intro: Preprints of your library that may now have a published version. Nothing changes until you confirm a proposal.
published.alreadyOwned: Another document of your library already has this DOI: this may be that document, so applying is not offered.
published.ownOnlyHint: Uses the author names of your profile (Settings).
published.checked: {{checked}} documents checked, {{count}} proposals, {{failed}} could not be checked.
published.notChecked: Not looked up yet. Nothing is checked until you ask.

sources.intro: What you follow. Checks run only when you ask, from the New tab.
sources.queryHint_author: An OpenAlex author id (like A123) or a name.
sources.queryHint_venue: A venue name or an OpenAlex source id (like S123).
sources.queryHint_own-preprint: Uses the author names of your profile.
sources.label: Label
sources.labelHint: Optional; shown instead of the query.
